title: Functions determining $(q+3)/2$ directions over the finite field with $q$ elements
summary: Let $q=p^n$, where $p>2$ is prime. We prove that every $q$-set $U\subseteq\mathrm{AG}(2,q)$ determining exactly $(q+3)/2$ directions is affinely equivalent to the graph of $x^{(q+1)/2}$. For $n\ge2$, we also prove that a $q$-set determining at most $(q+p)/2$ directions is either an affine $\mathbb{F}_p$-linear set or affinely equivalent to this graph. The classification for $n=1$ is due to Lovász and Schrijver. For $n=2$, the classification and the stated stability result follow from results of Gács, Lovász, and Sz\H onyi and the direction theorems of Blokhuis, Ball, Brouwer, Storme, and…
